LMR33630 is also internally compensated (no COMP pin) vs AP64350's external Type-II network (R5/C2/C3) - a swap needs a new schematic, not a footprint drop-in. Rejected at P2 (decisions.md D1) on guaranteed-vs-typical Rds(on): its typical conduction loss is +260mW vs AP64350's guaranteed max, worth ~4.9C of Tj on a board that closes with ~7C of margin.
